examples.title: The Effects of Tasimelteon in Participants With REM Behavior Disorder (RBD)
examples.why: Study will not longer be done. Terminated due to sponsor noncompliance.

summary: Tasimelteon has a warning that it can cause extreme sleepiness, so people should only get ready for bed after taking it because it harms their ability to stay fully alert [3]. A small computer model, not tests done on actual people, gave the drug low scores for liver and heart risks [M]. In addition, a clinical study looking at the drug's effects on a sleep condition called REM behavior disorder was stopped because the sponsor did not follow the rules [5].
